thread:
rico: quick thread — UX + policy question: should SLO threshold presets in console include a "cost impact" estimate (monthly alerting quota / notify ops cost)? product wants engineers to understand unit economics before accepting tighter thresholds. thoughts? :money_with_wings:

anya: love the idea. show estimated monthly alert count and estimated notify cost delta. we can compute from historical firing rate and current notify fanout. small caveat: estimates are fuzzy for low-sample tenants. show confidence level.

samir: agree. also propose "alert tier" presets: low/medium/high sensitivity maps to percentiles and a projected quota burn. presets: low -> p99, medium -> p95, high -> p90? or maybe use multipliers on baseline.

rico: would be neat to let ops set org-level budget (alerts/month) and then show how many tenants are near the limit. console could flag orgs at risk.

quota-bot: projection job queued: quota-estimate-run-2026-06 for cohort=10% start=2945680200 duration=48h. output -> /telemetry/quota/projections/2945680200

anya: UI idea: preset cards with: name, threshold, est_monthly_alerts, est_cost_delta, confidence, apply_button, preview_sim. clicking preview sim runs 24h shadow for that tenant and shows timeline.

samir: on backend add fields to proposal API: {proposed_threshold, est_alerts_per_month, est_notify_cost_usd, confidence, sample_count}. require audit_reason on apply if est_cost_delta > threshold.

rico: rollout: start as read-only projection in console (no routing changes) and surface preset cards. after 2 weeks, enable staged apply with per-org budget guardrails. emergency pause if notify_queue_depth > X.

ops-bot: note: created backpressure hook /infra/ops/hooks/quota-backpressure. will alert when projected org cost delta > 20% of configured budget.

anya: i'll mockup the cards and small API patch. tagging @samir for schema + cost calc review. :thumbsup: 

samir: will add a lightweight cost model: est_cost = est_alerts * avg_notify_cost_per_alert_by_region. default cost table and per-org overrides. also include amortized infra cost factor.

rico: great — thanks team. small follow-up: include a "compare two presets" toggle in the UI so customers can see tradeoffs.
